text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The joint ceasefire commission is to meet on Thursday to check if the government and UNITA former rebels have complied with U.N. Security Council resolutions on their military demobilisation obligations prescribed by the Lusaka Protocol.
- South Africa's De Beers DBRS.Z is to begin prospecting for diamonds in the Mavinga area of Cuango Cubango Province next May, company special representative James McLuskie said.
- U.N. special envoy to Angola Alioune Blondin Beye said dangers of a new war in Angola were over.
